def generate_inputs(device):
    batch, rows, cols = 16, 256, 256
    # Start with uniform large values
    x = torch.ones((batch, rows, cols), dtype=torch.float32, device=device) * 100.0
    # Place minimum at diagonal: row i has minimum at column i
    for row_idx in range(rows):
        x[:, row_idx, row_idx] = -100.0
    return [x]
